name: obsidian-vault
description: Safely search, read, create, and update Obsidian Markdown notes while reconciling them with relevant conversation context and memory.

interface.shortDescription: Combine verified Obsidian notes with relevant memory.
interface.longDescription: Searches Obsidian before answering questions that may depend on saved notes, then reconciles verified notes with relevant conversation or saved memory. Obsidian facts stay clearly sourced; useful memory-only facts are included as unverified. Writes are guarded against concurrent changes.
defaultPrompt: Check Obsidian and available memory, then tell me my current tasks and separate verified facts from unverified additions.
Reconcile the relevant Obsidian notes with remembered context and name the source notes.
Update the corresponding note in Obsidian.
Save this as a new note in Obsidian.
